Get the game on GOG ↗

Bring your game

1. Open Gunslugs 2 on GOG in your owned library and download the full Windows offline backup installer for the supported build (fingerprint listed below). Download every accompanying .bin part, if listed, and keep them beside the .exe. Use the full installer, not a patch or the Galaxy installer. 2. Run the installer on Windows and open the installed game directory. Find Gunslugs2.jar beside the game executable. Enable file extensions in Explorer so its name is visible. 3. Copy that file unchanged into the installed port at <ports directory>/gunslugs2/Gunslugs2.jar. Keep its exact name, capitalization and spaces. The Windows EXE and bundled Windows Java runtime are not needed.

Alternatively, extract your full offline installer using innoextract. Run innoextract -d extracted "your-full-offline-installer.exe", then locate Gunslugs2.jar inside the extracted files (usually extracted/app/) and copy it to the same destination. Installer layouts vary; use Windows installation if your extractor cannot read that installer. Do not unpack or rename the game archive itself.

No game-data conversion is required on a PC or handheld. The handheld verifies the supplied archive and creates its save folders. It cannot generate the purchased game data from nothing.

Supported archive SHA-256 (Gunslugs2.jar):

8f92f9ea2f84b055be744f98b911dbcdc6f8199bd1ec75b54338bff3ffffa913

Compare it with Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 "Gunslugs2.jar" in PowerShell, or sha256sum "Gunslugs2.jar" on Linux. A different build needs a compatibility check.

Install the port

  1. Update PortMaster. Copy Gunslugs2.zip into its autoinstall/ folder and open PortMaster.
  2. Allow PortMaster to download Java 17 and Westonpack. An internet connection is needed if these runtimes are not installed.
  3. Copy the owned game files into gunslugs2/ as described above. Launch Gunslugs 2 from your ports menu.
Manual installation paths

1. Update PortMaster. Put Gunslugs2.zip in PortMaster's autoinstall/ directory, then open PortMaster to install it. Connect to the network to download Java 17 and Westonpack if they are not installed yet. 2. Copy the owned file to <ports directory>/gunslugs2/Gunslugs2.jar. 3. Launch Gunslugs 2 from your firmware's ports menu.

For manual installation on muOS, extract the ZIP on your computer and copy Gunslugs 2.sh to <SD card>/roms/PORTS/, and the gunslugs2/ folder to <SD card>/ports/ on the card configured as the firmware's ports location. The required file is <SD card>/ports/gunslugs2/Gunslugs2.jar.

For ArkOS/dArkOS and standard ports layouts, extract the ZIP into your configured ports directory (for example /roms/ports/ or /roms2/ports/) so Gunslugs 2.sh and gunslugs2/ are beside each other. Use the firmware's configured ports location; the launcher uses PortMaster's directory value. Avoid creating an extra Gunslugs2/ wrapper folder.

Saves & troubleshooting

Back up gunslugs2/saves/ before updates. Read gunslugs2/log.txt if startup fails. Report your device, exact firmware version, resolution and steps to reproduce, and attach the log. Test menu navigation, gameplay, audio, game speed, save/reload, suspend/resume and clean exit. Keep purchased game files private.
